messages.author: b438a2920a8af647
messages.subject: MAGIC design
parts: Hi I have three different recipient parents crossed with one donor parent separately. I have ~100 RILs from each of these three crosses. Can I use R/qtl2 for this design? what should be the cross design?

messages.author: 96353e7106735838
messages.subject: Re: [Rqtl2-disc] MAGIC design
parts:
I would view this as a NAM population, rather than MAGIC. They would need to be treated as three separate two-way RIL, with cross type "riself". R/qtl2 doesn't currently have the functionality for a combined analysis of three crosses.

karl
